in_sanskrit.name: दीनदयл
in_sanskrit.meaning: The merciful one who is free from desire or anger
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is free from desire or anger (deen) and is merciful (dayal).

in_hindi.name: दीनदयाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is free from desire or anger (दीन) and is merciful (दयाल).

in_tamil.name: தீனதயல்
in_tamil.meaning: ஜனன்பவம் குடியிடம் அல்லது அரியம் இல்லையாவ், அவ்வை அல்லவாய் அல்லது அரியம் உண்டுவது

in_marathi.name: Deendayal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Servant of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deendayal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Deendayal is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deen’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Dayal’ meaning ‘compassionate’ or ‘merciful’. This name signifies a servant of God who is compassionate and merciful towards all.

vedic_reference.note: Deendayal is a name found in Hindu mythology and is associated with the sage Valmiki. The sage Valmiki was once an angry man, but when he was blessed by Lord Rama, he became a sage and took the name Deendayal, meaning 'the merciful one who is free from desire or anger'.
